typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings with tracking-tight. DO NOT use Inter for headings to avoid a generic look. Use Inter for body text for optimal legibility. Ensure strict hierarchy (e.g., H1 max text-5xl/6xl, H2 text-3xl/4xl).

colors.instructions: Strictly adhere to Deep Industrial Navy (#111827) and Steel Grey (#374151). Use the copper/metallic orange accent (#D97706) sparingly for primary CTAs, indicators, and hover states. Never use pure #000000. Do not use generic full-screen gradients.

visual_enhancers.instructions: Employ 'Grid Borders' for a technical, precise industrial look (border-collapse layouts, subtle 1px borders using border-border/40). Use crisp edges with minimal border-radius (max 4px/sm). Incorporate layered shadows (ambient + direct) for interactive elements.

components.name: Navigation & Header
components.instructions: Compact sticky header (z-50). Use Solid Background (#111827) or Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border). Logo on the left, mega-nav/links centered, Request Quote button on the right. Must not overlap content (add pt-[header-height] to body/main).

components.name: Hero Section
components.instructions: Headline: 'PRECISION ENGINEERED. BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE.' Use Manrope, text-5xl/6xl. Subheadline about advanced solutions. Use an industrial hero image with a max overlay opacity of bg-black/40 (do not kill the image). Left align or smartly balance layout.

components.name: Product Categories & Grid
components.instructions: 12 categories: Ringlock System, Ringlock Accessories, Cuplock System, Support Railings, Kwikstage System, Ladders Brackets Gates & Accessories, Screw Base Jacks, Walk Boards & Steel Planks, Steel Props, Forged & Pressed Couplers, Framework Accessories, Frames. Use a High-Density Grid layout for catalogs (gap-4/6) with cardless or subtle 1px border card styling. Include product image, name, short desc, item code, 'View Product' and 'Request Quote' actions.

components.name: Product Detail Page
components.instructions: Two-column layout. Left: Image gallery (main image + thumbnails) with zoom and fullscreen preview. Right: Product name, item code, description, specifications rendered in a clean HTML table, 'Request a Quote' / 'Send Enquiry' buttons.

components.name: Forms & Modals
components.instructions: Use customized Shadcn UI Dialogs for the Enquiry/Quote modals. Forms should use Shadcn Input, Select, and Textarea with crisp borders and subtle focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).

components.name: Buttons
components.instructions: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) buttons. Apply interaction micro-animations (hover:translate-y-[-2px] shadow-md). Explicitly set hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-accent/90 hover:text-white). Use Accent color for primary CTAs only.

grids_layouts.instructions: Implement High Density Grids (Mode B) for Data/Catalogs. Use col-span-1 to col-span-4 logic. Override grid stretch with align-items: start where necessary. Elements must align optically. Mobile-first responsive grids.

motion.instructions: Subtle micro-interactions only. Hover states must be distinct. Provide staggered entrance animations for the product catalog list. Do not use 'transition: all' (specify transform/opacity/colors).

accessibility.instructions: Ensure WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text). Focus states must clearly outline the element. Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).

media.instructions: Product images must have max-h-[80vh] on mobile to prevent layout distortion. Include context/subjects in images where possible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install @phosphor-icons/react using yarn for high-end duotone industrial icons.
Update tailwind.config.js and src/index.css to implement the defined colors (Primary #111827, Secondary #374151, Accent #D97706, Background #F8FAFC).
Remove default React boilerplate text-alignment centered in App.css (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Construct the UI adhering to an 'International Premium Industrial B2B' aesthetic. Avoid cartoonish, over-rounded, or whimsical details.
Set up the 12 product categories correctly in the Product Catalogue. Implement text search and filtering mechanisms.
Implement the 'Request a Quote' process comprehensively (Button -> Modal/Page).
Build the 'Catalogue' page with a clear visual call-to-action for downloading the PDF.
Use Shadcn components for Select, Tabs, Dialogs, and Tables but customize their appearance to match the industrial theme (remove Vercel-look soft shadows, use crisp 1px borders).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid AI slop aesthetic. Create distinctive frontends that look premium.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or heavily structured grid layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) thoughtfully (e.g., sticky nav).
Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) in the UI.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states, transitions.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use only the provided Unsplash URLs.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
